capabilities: DML, forests, heterogeneous effects and IV; panel DynamicDML
limitation: Estimator-specific exchangeability, IV and panel restrictions; preserve groups in fitting
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.role: Heterogeneous effects and dynamic moment estimation
scientific_qualification.input: Outcome, treatment, controls, heterogeneity features and estimator-specific IV or equal-length trajectory groups.
scientific_qualification.output: A selected CATE or structural blip coefficient with its model-specific inference object.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Exchangeability or valid-IV assumptions, residual relevance, specified treatment-response form, and independent/dependent sampling assumptions appropriate to the selected estimator.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: For inspected DynamicDML, sort and validate actual periods, require equal group lengths and group-aware splitting, restrict heterogeneity features to baseline. Reject nontrivial sample_weight or sample_var because fit warns and ignores both. Do not pad missing periods without an observation model.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Permute rows then reconstruct chronological groups and obtain equivalent inputs; reject duplicate/missing periods and unsupported weights. Compare the backward blip solution with a finite linear oracle.

evidence.finding: Equal-length groups, occurrence-order periods, baseline heterogeneity, group-aware CV; weights and sample variance ignored.
